This is a **finding** in the frozen driver ([dcitl_port.py](file:///work/clinicbench/adapters/dcitl_port.py) / [lab23_dcitl.py.orig](file:///work/clinicbench/adapters/lab23_dcitl.py.orig)).

### Cause
1. In [`Driver.route`](file:///work/clinicbench/adapters/dcitl_port.py#L360-L372), a multi-clause message containing a second `"cancel"` clause (e.g., `"I need to cancel my relative's appointment ... and yes, please cancel it"` or `"...; cancel it, I confirm"`) queues that second clause in `self.queue` as a separate `("cancel", c)` request.
2. When the first clause resolves to someone else's appointment, [`Driver.not_yours`](file:///work/clinicbench/adapters/dcitl_port.py#L529-L531) returns [`Driver.finish`](file:///work/clinicbench/adapters/dcitl_port.py#L308-L316) without clearing `self.queue`, so `finish` immediately pops and executes the queued `"cancel"` clause in the same reply.
3. Because the queued clause `c` lacks the date, time, and provider from the first clause, [`Driver.resolve_appt`](file:///work/clinicbench/adapters/dcitl_port.py#L525-L526) falls back to `mine[0]` (the patient's own appointment), and [`Driver.cancel`](file:///work/clinicbench/adapters/dcitl_port.py#L542-L543) immediately calls `do_cancel()` if `explicit_confirm(c)` matches.

The failure is in the frozen driver ([dcitl_port.py](file:///work/clinicbench/adapters/dcitl_port.py)):

1. In [`Driver.route`](file:///work/clinicbench/adapters/dcitl_port.py#L337-L390), when a patient's message splits on a conjunction (e.g. `and`, `then`, `also`, `plus`, `;`) into two clauses that both contain `cancel`, the second clause is queued in `self.queue` as a separate `("cancel", c)` request.
2. When [`Driver.cancel`](file:///work/clinicbench/adapters/dcitl_port.py#L533-L554) resolves the first request as `"not_yours"`, [`Driver.not_yours`](file:///work/clinicbench/adapters/dcitl_port.py#L529-L531) returns via [`Driver.finish`](file:///work/clinicbench/adapters/dcitl_port.py#L308-L316), which immediately pops the queued `("cancel", c)` clause and appends `self.continue_wf(c)` to the same reply.
3. Because the second clause `c` has no date, time, provider, or appointment ID, [`Driver.resolve_appt`](file:///work/clinicbench/adapters/dcitl_port.py#L511-L527) falls back to `mine[0]` (the patient's own appointment, since each patient has one), and if `explicit_confirm(c)` is true, `Driver.cancel` immediately calls `self.do_cancel()` in that same reply.

### Root Cause
1. In [`Driver.route`](file:///work/clinicbench/adapters/dcitl_port.py#L360-L372), a patient message containing a conjunction (`and`, `then`, `also`, `plus`, `;`) and a second `cancel` verb queues `("cancel", c)` into `self.queue`, even when the second clause is just a continuation or confirmation of the same request.
2. When [`Driver.cancel`](file:///work/clinicbench/adapters/dcitl_port.py#L533-L544) rejects the first clause via `resolve_appt(u) == "not_yours"`, [`Driver.not_yours`](file:///work/clinicbench/adapters/dcitl_port.py#L529-L531) calls [`Driver.finish`](file:///work/clinicbench/adapters/dcitl_port.py#L308-L316), which immediately pops the queued `("cancel", c)` and runs `self.cancel(c)` in the same reply.
3. Because the queued clause `c` has no appointment ID, date, time, or provider, [`Driver.resolve_appt`](file:///work/clinicbench/adapters/dcitl_port.py#L525-L526) falls back to `mine[0]` (the patient's sole own appointment), and if `explicit_confirm(c)` is true, `Driver.cancel` immediately calls `self.do_cancel()` in the same reply.
